theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 51 群

items.pos: n. 家庭 | adj. 家用的
items.colloc: household appliance 家用電器 | average household 平均家庭
items.distinct: family 家庭成員 | home 住處
ex: The company targets every household in the city.
這家公司鎖定市內每個家庭為目標。
She manages all the household expenses carefully.
她仔細地管理所有的家庭開銷。
This is a well-known household name in Taiwan.
這是台灣家喻戶曉的品牌名稱。

items.colloc: indeed true 的確屬實 | thank you indeed 非常感謝
items.distinct: actually 事實上 | certainly 當然
ex: The report was indeed helpful for our meeting.
這份報告確實對我們的會議很有幫助。
It is indeed a challenging task for us.
對我們來說，這確實是一項艱鉅的任務。
He was indeed surprised by the positive result.
他對這個正面的結果確實感到驚訝。

items.colloc: indicated that 顯示出 | clearly indicated 明確指出
items.distinct: point out 指出（細節）| show 表現
ex: The data indicated a rise in sales figures.
數據顯示銷售數字有所成長。
Her tone indicated that she was not satisfied.
她的語氣顯示她並不滿意。
The sign indicated the location of the exit.
標示牌指出了出口的位置。

items.colloc: insist on 堅持要 | insist that 堅稱
items.distinct: persist 堅持不懈 | demand 強求
ex: I must insist on reviewing the contract again.
我必須堅持再次審閱合約。
They insisted that the delivery be made today.
他們堅持今天必須完成配送。
He insisted on paying for the business lunch.
他堅持要支付這次商務午餐的費用。

items.pos: n. 機構；學院 | v. 制定；創立
items.colloc: research institute 研究機構 | institute a policy 制定政策
items.distinct: institution 機構（較廣義）| organization 組織
ex: The research institute released a new report today.
該研究機構今天發布了一份新報告。
We plan to institute a new training program.
我們計畫制定一項新的培訓計畫。
She works at a prestigious financial training institute.
她在一家知名的金融培訓學院工作。

items.pos: n. 侮辱 | v. 羞辱
items.colloc: a personal insult 個人侮辱 | feel insulted 感到被羞辱
items.distinct: offense 冒犯 | ridicule 嘲笑
ex: His comments were taken as a direct insult.
他的評論被視為直接的侮辱。
It is unprofessional to insult a client openly.
公開羞辱客戶是不專業的行為。
The manager never intended to insult the staff.
經理絕無意羞辱員工。

items.colloc: an inviting atmosphere 誘人的氣氛 | inviting offer 吸引人的報價
items.distinct: attractive 有吸引力的 | tempting 誘惑的
ex: The office has a warm and inviting design.
辦公室有著溫暖且吸引人的設計。
This sounds like a very inviting opportunity indeed.
這聽起來確實是一個非常吸引人的機會。
We created an inviting space for our clients.
我們為客戶創造了一個舒適誘人的空間。

items.pos: n. 比賽；對手；搭配 | v. 相配；與...吻合
items.colloc: perfect match 絕配 | match the requirements 符合要求
items.distinct: game 比賽（遊戲）| suit 合適
ex: These colors match our company logo perfectly.
這些顏色與我們公司標誌非常搭配。
Our prices match those of our main competitors.
我們的價格與主要競爭對手相當。
He is a strong match for the sales position.
他是業務職位的人選強敵。

items.colloc: Ministry of Finance 財政部 | government ministry 政府部門
items.distinct: department 部門（公司內）| bureau 局
ex: The ministry announced new economic policies today.
該部今天宣布了新的經濟政策。
He works for the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
他在經濟部任職。
Several ministry officials attended the seminar.
幾位政府官員參加了研討會。

items.colloc: nursing home 護理之家 | nursing staff 護理人員
items.distinct: care 照顧 | medical treatment 醫療
ex: She decided to pursue a career in nursing.
她決定從事護理工作。
The hospital hired more nursing staff this month.
醫院本月聘請了更多護理人員。
He requires professional nursing around the clock.
他需要全天候的專業照料。

items.colloc: a worthy opponent 可敬的對手 | political opponent 政治對手
items.distinct: competitor 競爭對手（商業）| enemy 敵人
ex: The CEO respected her main business opponent.
執行長尊敬她的主要商業對手。
Our team is ready to face the opponent.
我們的團隊準備好面對對手了。
He is a strong opponent of the new tax law.
他是新稅法的強烈反對者。

items.pos: n. 產量；輸出 | v. 生產
items.colloc: factory output 工廠產量 | increase output 增加產量
items.distinct: production 生產 | product 產品
ex: The factory increased its output by ten percent.
該工廠產量增加了百分之十。
High output is essential for meeting the deadline.
高產出對於趕上截止日期至關重要。
We need to analyze the data output carefully.
我們需要仔細分析數據輸出結果。

items.colloc: overly optimistic 過度樂觀 | overly critical 過度挑剔
items.distinct: extremely 極端地 | excessively 過量地
ex: Do not be overly concerned about the small details.
不要過度擔心小細節。
The report was overly critical of the management.
這份報告對管理層過度挑剔。
He is not overly enthusiastic about the project.
他對這個專案沒有表現得過度熱情。

items.colloc: pension plan 退休金計畫 | receive a pension 領取退休金
items.distinct: bonus 獎金 | salary 薪水
ex: The company offers a comprehensive pension plan.
公司提供完善的退休金計畫。
Employees can start their pension savings now.
員工現在就可以開始存退休金。
He plans to retire and live on his pension.
他計畫退休並依靠退休金生活。

items.colloc: perhaps not 也許不會 | perhaps the best 也許是最好的
items.distinct: maybe 也許 | possibly 可能
ex: Perhaps we should consider another business strategy.
也許我們該考慮另一種商業策略。
It is perhaps the most important meeting this year.
這或許是今年最重要的一次會議。
Perhaps you can finish the report by tomorrow.
也許你可以在明天前完成報告。

items.pos: n. 同情；遺憾 | v. 同情
items.colloc: a pity that 可惜的是 | feel pity 對...感到同情
items.distinct: regret 後悔 | sympathy 同情心
ex: It is a pity that we missed the deadline.
很遺憾我們錯過了截止日期。
He felt pity for the struggling small business.
他對那家掙扎的小企業感到同情。
What a pity to lose such a talented employee.
失去這麼有才華的員工真是可惜。

items.pos: v. 擦亮；潤飾 | n. 光澤
items.colloc: polish the skills 磨練技能 | polish the presentation 潤飾簡報
items.distinct: shine 發光 | improve 改進
ex: She needs to polish her presentation before Friday.
她需要在週五前潤飾她的簡報。
We should polish our communication skills daily.
我們應該每天磨練我們的溝通技巧。
The team will polish the final project draft.
團隊將會潤飾專案的最終草稿。

items.pos: v. 造成（威脅/問題）；擺姿勢 | n. 姿勢
items.colloc: pose a threat 構成威脅 | pose a challenge 造成挑戰
items.distinct: cause 引起 | situation 情況
ex: Rising costs pose a threat to our profits.
成本上升對我們的利潤構成威脅。
The new regulations pose a challenge to us.
新法規對我們造成了挑戰。
The complex task poses several difficult questions.
這項複雜的任務提出了幾個難題。

items.colloc: primary goal 主要目標 | primary concern 首要顧慮
items.distinct: main 主要的 | initial 初期的
ex: Our primary goal is to increase customer satisfaction.
我們的主要目標是提高客戶滿意度。
Safety is our primary concern in this factory.
安全是我們在這家工廠的首要顧慮。
The primary focus should be on market growth.
主要的焦點應放在市場成長上。

items.pos: v. 拉；拖；吸引（pull 的過去式與過去分詞）
items.colloc: pulled back 撤回 | pulled out 退出
items.distinct: pushed 推 | dragged 拖拉
ex: The company pulled the product from the market.
公司將該產品從市場上撤回。
He pulled a chair over to join the discussion.
他拉了一張椅子過來參與討論。
The investor pulled out of the joint venture.
投資者退出了這項合資計畫。
